capabilities: Insert a YouTube transcript at the cursor with clickable timestamps
Display a video's transcript in a side panel with timestamps
Open the video at a timestamp by clicking it
Configure timestamp frequency and panel placement
extras: Documents its network and clipboard usage: fetches captions from YouTube (InnerTube API) with no accounts, telemetry or analytics; requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull a YouTube video's caption track into notes or view it alongside the video.

summary: YouTube transcript fetcher that inserts transcripts with clickable timestamps into notes or shows them in a searchable side panel.
